law_name: Proposition de loi relative à l'aide à mourir (right to assisted dying)
description: As a deputy, Panifous was a rapporteur (notably for articles 5 and 6) of the bill establishing a right to assisted dying, examined in the National Assembly in first reading in spring 2025. He co-signed the committee report with Stéphane Delautrette and Élise Leboucher (Social Affairs Committee, May 2025).
significance: One of the most consequential bioethics texts of the legislature. Panifous described it as 'a text I believe is measured'. The Assembly adopted the bill, but the Senate rejected the assisted-dying component and a joint committee (CMP) failed, sending it back to the Assembly. As Minister for Relations with Parliament he later steered its return to the Assembly in 2026.
